fields.note: Air admitted for relief or to dump lift cannot be pumped back in flight: 034's onboard pumps need 264-416 h (E2M28) or 8,062-12,709 h (KNF N920) at R10. Re-evacuation is a ground task, about 16-20 h per flown day at 052's effective ground speed (1574.9 m3/h per 4188.8 m3), against 24.5 h for a full evacuation. Energy is bracketed: ideal isothermal 23-50 kWh (R10) to 900-1,530 kWh (R30) per day; Edwards GXS-class sets list 1,900-2,200 m3/h and 7.5-29.5 kW rated across the family (not tied to a model). P3 admitted air must be dried for the 052/054 dry cavity. After a pressure fall, trim air lowers lift with no in-flight recovery.
